# R8.5 failure-injection table (GENERATED by tools/gen_fit_doc_r85.py from test output)

Firmware rows run the real F133 loader/service code (firmware/src) against a behavioural board model (firmware/tests/ecp5_mock.c). RTL rows are tb_ecp5_top (Icarus) on the real ECP5 RTL with the APS6404L model. No hardware was used. Every case returns to a defined state: P1 launcher with the FPGA powered down and isolated, or a documented degraded mode. NOR boot, BT820 graphics and USB never depend on the FPGA: the service never touches SPI1, and the NOR CS line is owned by the F133.
